title: Causal FIR Filtering and Dataset-Conditional Text Benefits in an HSTU-Style Pure-PyTorch Sequential Recommender (code and evaluation artifacts)
description: Code, pre-registrations, provenance manifests, and evaluation artifacts for an HSTU-style pure-PyTorch sequential recommender on the Amazon Reviews 2023 5-core benchmark. Includes: the strictly causal FIR temporal filter and its ablations; the pre-registered Musical_Instruments point-estimate confirmation (fresh seeds, dual kernels, provenance manifests, per-user sidecars); the dataset-conditional long-tail pattern and titration interventions; a fail-closed artifact-graph build (build_hstu_tables.py --submission / rebuild_hstu_submission.py --strict) that recomputes every printed number from source artifacts; the bitwise HSTU core-block parity test; and the shim harness that executes the reference HSTU-BLaIR implementation locally (THEIRS_ON_OURS_REPORT.md). The Amazon Reviews 2023 dataset itself is not redistributed; derived splits and caches are identified by SHA256 with regeneration scripts (RELEASE_MANIFEST.json).
